checks.explanation: Biden did not drop out before the scheduled George Stephanopoulos interview aired as planned.
The interview was widely seen as an underwhelming performance, but Biden did not immediately drop out afterward; he continued for several more weeks before withdrawing on July 21, 2024.
Democrats did not hold a multi-debate speed-run primary process; Kamala Harris was effectively coronated as the nominee without a competitive primary or debates.
While Kamala Harris did become the Democratic nominee, she lost the November 2024 election to Donald Trump and never became president.
The 2024 Democratic nominee ended up being Kamala Harris, consistent with the prediction that it would be either Biden or Harris and no other candidate.
Texas did not enact a law banning or disabling browser incognito mode.
No US recession occurred in the period following this prediction; the economy continued to grow through 2024 and 2025.
The Democratic Party did in fact replace Biden with Kamala Harris as its 2024 nominee, contrary to this prediction.
